options.reason: The table was assembled to classify steel-plate surface defects, and the seven binary fault columns are joint categorical outcomes describing the same plate at different defect-type levels, so RL-0002 makes them multilabel targets rather than leakage suspects of one another; geometry, luminosity and index columns are candidate features. The paired A300/A400 flags are complementary recodings of one steel-type attribute and are flagged as redundant/leakage-prone encodings rather than outcomes.
options.title: multilabel
